    The AI's playing decision and the independent post-hoc audit are shown separately. Q is the configured rollout objective from the mover's perspective; Δ ref is the paired difference against the marked selection reference. A fresh coherent panel checks whether the same numerical leader repeats, but that stability check is not proof that a move is best. The audit examines its focused top-policy shortlist, not every legal move. The value line is the network evaluation from P1's perspective before each move.
